bugs.bug: get_route_path removes root_path with an unanchored-at-the-end regex and without escaping, so a root_path that is a string prefix of the path (for example /app and /application) is stripped from the middle of a different segment
bugs.example: _utils.py: re.sub(r"^" + root_path, ...) strips root_path as a plain string prefix, so root_path '/app' also removes the start of '/application/x', producing a wrong route path (and root_path is not regex-escaped)
